## Problem and behavior

Normal Decision contention could expose an empty final after `open("wx")`, or observe ENOENT after EEXIST and a legitimate release, producing GATE_CORRUPT before Decision OCC. The approved D1–D4 contract from PR #85 is implemented here; malformed/unverifiable final gates still stop and are never unlocked automatically.

Completed same-directory wx/0600 candidates are file-synced/read back and exclusively hard-linked to final. Directory sync and exact creation-inode/bytes verification precede a live nominal lease. Publication ambiguity returns no authority and retains evidence; release revokes before unlink and never retries against another owner. Namespace races use fresh exclusive attempts bounded to eight retries/one monotonic second within Decision's existing five-second budget.

## Scope and safety

- Update only the approved section10.1 normative deltas, shared Gate publisher/lease, exact candidate classification, Decision budget, direct regressions, Linux Node20/24 CI coverage and minimal operational guidance.
- Discovery retains candidate raw observations; candidates are excluded from generic publisher cleanup and transaction ArtifactRef authority. Orphans are not adopted/deleted/reused.
- Existing schemas/ID rules/hash projections, Recovery predicates, immutable terminal evidence, CLI actions and exit table remain unchanged. The old CLI corrupt-final test now expects the approved own candidate retention while asserting every existing artifact's bytes/inode, exact addition count/structure and unchanged exit8/no dispatch.
- No Production Bootstrap/Apply/Recovery, production data/staging changes, force unlock, bypass, weaker filesystem fallback or SCR-002/API/DB work.

## Evidence

Final runtime/test source ledger: `12f1205d3e7719ea6c6750359236ba4161adeff52645b44c567e32f3b250cc0f` (identical before/after each final run).

| Validation | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Final focused | 148 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip / 0 cancelled, exit0 |
| Same-device Linux gate/crash | 66 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip / 0 cancelled, exit0; fixture device27 = repo device27 |
| Ordinary unfiltered serial npm test | 795 pass / 0 fail / 1 existing skip / 0 cancelled, exit0; complete TAP/JSONL and unchanged source |
| FN-004 named test files (subset of full) | 627 pass / 0 fail / 1 existing skip / 0 cancelled |
| CLI files (subset) | 44 pass, including18 actual SIGKILL boundaries |
| Rankings / Site | each exit0; anomaly_count0 |
| Markdown | 33 files / 522 links / 16 fragments / broken0 |
| Generated diff / git diff --check | PASS |

Full-run command: `npm test -- --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=<TAP> --test-reporter=<JSONL reporter> --test-reporter-destination=<JSONL>`. Duration9,546,461.949ms. The single existing local skip checks the actual GitHub Actions checkout; local fixtures run and CI executes that check. No assertion/timeout/new skip relaxation. The filesystem suite includes14 real gate SIGKILL boundaries and a separate-process link race; existing6A–6F I/O/restart suites passed in the full run.

The forced pre-fix Decision race regression fails on isolated base main, while the new implementation reaches one winner and DECISION_HEAD_CONFLICT for the loser. An actual held-gate probe returns GATE_BUSY after ~5002ms without changing owner bytes or dispatching domain work. A read+close double-I/O regression first failed (47/1, exit1); the implementation now preserves the original EACCES/descriptor and secondary close error. Superseded/interrupted full runs are retained and are not treated as PASS.

Production: 17 entries, SHA256 `f7062983872a7e79f8fa99bf396429124437b62aa0d724df761b7ab687da1cf0`, unchanged.

## Review / residual conditions

FA-M01 remains OPEN for independent review/merge/post-merge verification and separate Final Acceptance. This PR does not declare FN-004 accepted. Actual physical power-loss/storage flush guarantees, volume capacity thresholds/monitoring/evidence retention and a quiescent rollout remain operator prerequisites. No orphan GC or gate-only orphan automatic recovery is added. CI's Node20/24 compatibility and original full/build result must be assessed on this exact PR head.

See `docs/plans/FN-004-FA-M01-Gate-Publication.md` for GP01–GP16 and changed source/test links.
